articles.title: Cs Dark Flame
articles.summary: Broad soft gradient of orange, red and blue-grey with high metal flake, satin, flame-like blur. A lilac-grey marbled finish with big brown and red-blue patches, like heat-haze or oil on water; the contour lines turn into a pale silvery sheen.
articles.what: Up close: Large soft blotches of dark brown and rusty red, edged with blue-pink halos, floating in a field of lavender-grey contour lines that wrap like fingerprint ridges. Lines are 4 to 6 px apart, blobs 100 px or more. From a distance: A lilac-grey marbled finish with big brown and red-blue patches, like heat-haze or oil on water; the contour lines turn into a pale silvery sheen. Measured spec (average): metal 167, roughness 73, coat 101. Shine: satin. Metal: high. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, hood, hero panel.
Fits: gt / sports car, show car, stock car.

Open the AI copilot (the ✦ AI button, bottom right) and ask for it by name, for example "put Cs Dark Flame on the hood".
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Whole body: the broad patches need wide panels to read
Hood and roof: the biggest flats show the brown blobs
Black or white numbers with an outline; the brown blobs and busy lines swallow thin digits.
Black or white stripes and number plates: strong contrast on the pale marbling

Not listed in the picker: ask the AI copilot for it by name.
pitfalls: Not a flame fade: the old card says flame-like orange-red gradient, but the render is lilac-grey line marbling with brown and red patches
Not smooth satin: the contour lines are visible up close
Avoid: dark numbers on dark blue areas, next to other gradients.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 167 (strong pearl or anodized metal), roughness 73 (satin gloss), clearcoat 101 (satin or weak clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
